Add a Departure Reason

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn how to add a reason that HR can choose when an employee leaves the company, so that departures are recorded and reported consistently.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Departure Reasons

Click Departure Reasons.

4. New

Click New to add a line.

5. Name

Type the name, then press Tab.

6. Save

Click the save icon to keep the line.

7. The list

The new line is now part of the list. Click the column headings to finish.
